prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1380; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents our client in connection with injuries sustained in a rear-end collision involving a vehicle insured under your policy. Our client has suffered physical injuries and is currently receiving medical care, and we expect the resulting claim to involve substantial damages.

Effective immediately, please direct all communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. Any statements or requests for recorded information should be routed through this firm.

To allow us to evaluate the claim properly, please provide a certified copy of the declarations page for the policy in question, including the bodily injury liability limits and any other applicable coverage.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes claim files, photographs, vehicle and telematics data, adjuster notes, recorded statements, repair estimates, and any dashcam or surveillance footage. Please suspend any routine deletion or destruction of these materials while the claim is pending.
